server_host.description: Host address to bind the server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0', or IPv6)

server_port.description: Port number the server listens on

server_base_url.description: Base URL path for reverse proxy setups (e.g., '/bibledit'); must not contain trailing slash

storage_path.description: Absolute filesystem path for persistent user and Bible data storage

security_use_https.description: Enable HTTPS instead of HTTP; requires valid ssl_cert and ssl_key

security_ssl_cert.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format); required if use_https=true

security_ssl_key.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format); required if use_https=true

security_secure_cookies.description: Enforce secure flag on session cookies (only sent over HTTPS)

logging_level.description: Minimum log level; one of: debug, info, warning, error, critical

logging_file.description: Absolute path to the log file; empty string means log to stdout/stderr

features_enable_registration.description: Allow new user registration via the web interface

features_enable_guest_access.description: Enable anonymous guest access without login

features_enable_import_export.description: Permit importing/exporting of Bible projects and notes

features_enable_multi_language.description: Enable UI translation and multi-language support
